scripts.build:main: pnpm run build:deps && node scripts/clean-main.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-preload.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:deps && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:main && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env SCOPEGUARD_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.package:prepare: pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.package:win:dir: pnpm run package:prepare && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --projectDir .package/app --config ../../electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --dir --publish never && node scripts/verify-built-package.mjs
scripts.package:win: pnpm run package:prepare && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --projectDir .package/app --config ../../electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-built-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-installer.mjs
scripts.pilot:pi-runtime:staged: pnpm run package:prepare && cross-env SCOPEGUARD_PILOT_STAGE_ROOT=.package/app node scripts/pi-runtime-desktop-pilot.mjs
scripts.pilot:phase3:staged: pnpm run package:prepare && cross-env SCOPEGUARD_PILOT_STAGE_ROOT=.package/app node scripts/phase3-desktop-pilot.mjs
scripts.probe:pi-runtime:utility:host-node: pnpm run build:main && cross-env SCOPEGUARD_PI_UTILITY_PROBE_MODE=host-node node scripts/pi-runtime-utility-probe.mjs
scripts.probe:pi-runtime:utility:electron-node: pnpm run build:main && cross-env SCOPEGUARD_PI_UTILITY_PROBE_MODE=electron-run-as-node node scripts/pi-runtime-utility-probe.mjs
